description: Source code defining the Post model and related functions for Mattermost, including post validation, cloning, serialization, and reporting query handling.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Represents a message post in Mattermost, including metadata, message content, and related properties.

classes.name: PostEphemeral
classes.description: Represents an ephemeral post visible only to a specific user.

classes.name: PostPatch
classes.description: Used for updating existing posts with optional fields.

classes.name: PostReminder
classes.description: Contains data for scheduled reminders associated with posts.

classes.name: PostPriority
classes.description: Defines priority and acknowledgment settings for posts.

classes.name: PostPersistentNotifications
classes.description: Tracks persistent notification data for posts.

classes.name: MoveThreadParams
classes.description: Parameters for moving a thread to another channel.

classes.name: SearchParameter
classes.description: Encapsulates search terms and filters for post searches.

classes.name: AnalyticsPostCountsOptions
classes.description: Options for counting posts for analytics.

classes.name: ReportPostOptions
classes.description: Options for reporting and exporting posts.

classes.name: RewriteRequest
classes.description: Request structure for rewriting message content via AI.

classes.name: RewriteResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing rewritten message text.

classes.name: ReportPostOptionsCursor
classes.description: Opaque cursor for paginating report queries.

classes.name: ReportPostListResponse
classes.description: Response containing a list of posts and next cursor.

classes.name: ReportPostQueryParams
classes.description: Resolved query parameters for fetching posts from store.
